title: Nemesis Games
author: James S. A. Corey
summary: Fifth Expanse novel. The crew of the Rocinante splits up for private reasons, each member heading to a different world, just as old threats stir and the balance among Earth, Mars and the Belt starts to slip.
readIf: you like a long space-opera series that gives each member of the crew their own storyline.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier books, because this one draws heavily on what came before.

pairings.reason: A classic about the human cost of long wars between worlds, with a more bitter and personal tone.
A fast, ruthless story about a class system, rebellion and shifting loyalties across the solar system.
A more literary space epic with a similar interest in how scattered people end up converging.
